subtitle: Main Stage · Porch · Bandstand
_sources: Handoffs/tech-packs/Washington Park — Tech Pack DRAFT.md (2026-09-14), forms_config.WP_LOCATIONS + SERIES_LOCATION (Brian-confirmed 2026-09-06/09/11), venue_email.py WP blocks, CLAUDE.md venue table. Items marked confirm are unverified.
intro: What 3CDC provides at Washington Park, and what we need from you. Your series sets your stage; your advance email names your day-of contact. Text or call them when you're about 5 minutes out.

items.label: By series
items.text: Neo Soul Nights plays the Bandstand. Blues & Brews and Jazz At The Porch play the Porch.

items.label: Backline
items.text: None. Artists provide all instruments, amps and 1/4" cables.

items.label: Engineer
items.text: 3CDC provides an engineer who mixes FOH and monitors from FOH. Bringing your own? Say so on the advance form.

items.label: Main Stage PA
items.text: JBL: 1× SRX915 top + 8× SRX906 array per side, 2× SRX928 subs per side

items.label: Porch / Bandstand
items.text: Console and PA for the smaller stages

items.label: Sound limit
items.text: Strict 95 dBA-Slow at the FOH position, city ordinance, for house and touring engineers alike. The house engineer may baffle amps to bring stage volume down.

items.label: Arrival
items.text: Text or call your day-of contact when you're about 5 minutes out, and introduce yourself onsite as soon as you arrive.

items.label: Parking
items.text: We follow up with parking validations after you advance. Note large vehicles or trailers on the form.

items.label: Load-in point
items.text: Where to load in for each stage

items.label: Merch
items.text: You provide the seller, point of sale and bank. We provide a tent next to the stage with a table and chairs.

items.label: Dressing rooms
items.text: No indoor rooms. On request, a 10×10 tent with sidewalls (Main Stage and Bandstand).

items.label: Hospitality
items.text: Drink tickets and water for all performers and crew (third-party events: water only).

sections.title: House Rules
items: Family-friendly content only, including prerecorded tracks and sound check.
Stay on the stage: no crowd surfing, climbing or jumping off.
Nothing thrown or shot into the crowd.
Rain or shine; a lightning hold means clear the stage until the all-clear.
Payment after the performance. The full list is on the advance form.
